say:1:1062504001:1.text: Great, they've finally caught on! Now I have someone to play with again.
say:1:1062504001:1.source_cn: 太好了，奥利和芬妮终于学会了！以后又有人陪我玩了~
say:1:1062504001:1.male: Great, they've finally caught on! Now I have someone to play with again.
say:1:1062504001:1.female: Great, they've finally caught on! Now I have someone to play with again.

say:2:1062504002:1.text: Mister, thank you! You're the best! You're even good at Century Quest!
say:2:1062504002:1.male: Mister, thank you! You're the best! You're even good at Century Quest!
say:2:1062504002:1.female: Miss, thank you! You're the best! You're even good at Century Quest!

say:3:1062504003:1.text: Also, for helping me... I'll give you a shiny thing I found!
say:3:1062504003:1.source_cn: 我不能白白接受你的好意，这些东西就送给你吧！
say:3:1062504003:1.male: Also, for helping me... I'll give you a shiny thing I found!
say:3:1062504003:1.female: Also, for helping me... I'll give you a shiny thing I found!

say:4:1062504004:1.text: And just you wait! Someday, I'll beat even you at Century Quest!
say:4:1062504004:1.source_cn: 不过呀，你也不要太骄傲哦，说不定哪一天，我会比你更厉害呢！
say:4:1062504004:1.male: And just you wait! Someday, I'll beat even you at Century Quest!
